turns.question: for each district, which crop has the best yield per hectare?
turns.gold_sql:
WITH per_crop AS (
  SELECT p.district, c.crop,
         avg(c.actual_yield / p.area_hectares) AS yield_per_ha,
         rank() OVER (
           PARTITION BY p.district
           ORDER BY avg(c.actual_yield / p.area_hectares) DESC
         ) AS rk
  FROM agri.crop_cycle c
  JOIN agri.plot p ON p.id = c.plot_id
  WHERE c.actual_yield IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.district, c.crop
)
SELECT district, crop, yield_per_ha
FROM per_crop
WHERE rk = 1

         avg(c.actual_yield / p.area_hectares) AS yield_per_ha,
         rank() OVER (
           PARTITION BY p.district
           ORDER BY avg(c.actual_yield / p.area_hectares) DESC

  FROM agri.crop_cycle c

GROUP BY b.district, b.crop
